name: shutterfly
description: Search the Shutterfly product catalog and open products on shutterfly.com

interface.longDescription: Find Shutterfly photo books, cards, invitations, prints, home decor, and personalized gifts by describing what you need. Results show the product image, type, rating, and current price, with a link to personalize and order on shutterfly.com.
defaultPrompt: Find a photo book for a family vacation
Show me holiday cards I can personalize with my photos
What Shutterfly gifts are good for grandparents?

positive.description: Catalog search for a photo book by occasion.
positive.prompt: Find a photo book for a family vacation
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls search_catalog and renders the Shutterfly product carousel: each card shows the product image, product type, star rating, and current price. Shop Now opens the product page on shutterfly.com in a new tab. Results are photo books.

positive.description: Catalog search with a size and occasion in the query.
positive.prompt: Show me 5x7 wedding thank you cards
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls search_catalog and renders the Shutterfly product carousel: each card shows the product image, product type, star rating, and current price. Shop Now opens the product page on shutterfly.com in a new tab. Results are 5x7 wedding thank you cards.

positive.description: Catalog search for a gift product by holiday.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls search_catalog and renders the Shutterfly product carousel: each card shows the product image, product type, star rating, and current price. Shop Now opens the product page on shutterfly.com in a new tab. Results are personalized mugs.

positive.description: Search followed by a single-product detail request.
positive.prompt: Find canvas prints of my photos, then tell me more about the first one
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls search_catalog and renders the product carousel, then calls get_product for the first result and renders one product card with the image, description, options, rating, and current price. Shop Now opens that product on shutterfly.com.

positive.description: Comparison that needs two catalog searches.
positive.prompt: Compare Shutterfly canvas prints and framed prints
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls search_catalog for each product type, renders a product carousel for each, and summarises the differences in prose without repeating the prices and names already shown on the cards.

negative.description: Order status is not a catalog question; the plugin exposes no order tools.
Cart and checkout actions are not available; products are purchased on shutterfly.com.
negative.prompt: Add the first photo book to my cart and check out

negative.description: Unrelated to Shutterfly products; the plugin should not be invoked.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Seattle today?

publication.release_notes: First directory release. Search the Shutterfly catalog (search_catalog) and view one product (get_product). Results render as product cards with image, type, rating, and current price, linking to shutterfly.com.
